story.titleZh: 梅赛德斯：迈凯伦2026引擎劣势或与投入不足有关
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯对客户车队迈凯伦未能像厂队那样充分发挥2026年F1动力单元性能的问题提出了自己的解释，认为迈凯伦的引擎劣势可能与其投入不足有关，而非单纯的技术问题。
story.originalTitle: Just spend more? Mercedes' intriguing theory for McLaren's PU deficit
story.summaryEn: Mercedes has offered its own explanation for why customer team McLaren has not exploited the 2026 Formula 1 power unit as effectively as the works operation, suggesting the shortfall may stem from insufficient investment rather than purely technical issues.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯对于客户车队迈凯伦为何无法像厂队那样充分发掘其2026年F1动力单元的潜力，有着不同的解释。
卫冕冠军迈凯伦未能像梅赛德斯那样从动力单元中获得同样多的性能，一直是今年冠军争夺战发展中幕后的一大话题，而且据悉这至少让迈凯伦感到些许沮丧——车队至少曾暗示过这一点，尽管从未公开完整表达过。
回到7月的银石站，当时迈凯伦对厂队梅赛德斯赛车在排位赛中使用的动力小技巧表示惊讶，车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉说：“我们与高性能动力系统部门（HPP，即梅赛德斯高性能动力系统部门）在技术层面确实有持续的沟通，以确保我们用上这台动力单元所能提供的一切，它非常出色。这确实是一项伟大的技术。它蕴藏着大量性能，而这些性能也藏在使用细节之中。
"……我们当然还需要与高性能动力系统部门继续讨论其他一些因素，因为当我们观察直道上的表现时，即便考虑到他们（梅赛德斯）的风阻可能更小，仍然存在一些疑问。"
迈凯伦在本赛季初根据梅赛德斯提供的早期信息所选定的较短齿比，正是形成差异的一个因素。
但据梅赛德斯车队副领队布拉德利·洛德表示，动力单元运用方面的任何差异，其核心原因只是简单的知识产权流程和开支问题，而不是梅赛德斯有意给厂队任何偏袒。
“一切都符合规则，一切也都符合合同。我认为迈凯伦和其他客户车队，即阿尔派和威廉姆斯，都是非常出色的合作伙伴，他们提出高要求是理所当然的。他们选择梅赛德斯，是因为他们希望与一家能提供卓越支持和优秀产品的公司合作，”洛德说。
“位于布里克沃思的动力单元团队在过去多年为客户提供引擎供应的过程中已经证明，他们始终以非常公平和正确的方式行事。”
"在某些方面，或许不可避免地会出现一些被认为存在差距的地方，或者他们（客户车队）……感觉自己可能落后一步，尤其是在……大量的模拟工具方面，也就是预测动力单元和底盘等部件表现的能力上。
"而这些工具当中有许多是我们不仅在不克斯沃思、而且是在梅赛德斯底盘部门与不克斯沃思的高性能动力总成部门（HPP）之间共同开发的——当然，技术规则对于底盘部门的技术知识产权哪些可以在车队之间共享、哪些不可以，规定得非常明确。
"因此，在某些情况下，需要先做一些拆解梳理工作，才能把某些部分提供给客户车队——或者客户车队自己也需要开展工作并投入资金，把自己的预算上限资源投入到开发这些工具上，才能最大限度地发挥动力单元的性能。
"所以这大概是我们遇到复杂问题的一个方面——但在一套全新的规则体系下，而且是一套比以前更复杂的新规则体系下，这是可以理解的。
去年是该规则周期的最后一个赛季，迈凯伦在车队积分榜上以364分的优势击败了梅赛德斯，但目前却落后159分——不过凭借兰多·诺里斯，车队在匈牙利大奖赛上确实实现了统治级表现。
车队在夏休期间发布了对性能技术总监马克·坦普尔的采访，进一步揭示了动力单元使用方面的具体情况，印证了洛德所说的部分内容，同时也强调了车队目前作为客户车队的一个根本性特点，即处于'主要决策圈之外'。
"我认为其中一部分原因在于你对设计和安装有多大的影响力。我们确实有相当大的参与度，但最终梅赛德斯厂队要和高性能动力单元部门就相关事项拥有最终决定权。这不应被理解为我们的意见被忽视——只是最终我们不是完全掌握控制权的一方。
"高性能动力单元部门在比赛周末的工作方式是设立一个主队和若干客户支持团队。我们与客户支持团队密切合作，并与主项目组的人员保持着良好的关系。通过这种合作，我们对主项目组的运作有一定影响力——但我们无法保证他们会接受我们提出的要求。
"在这一点上，我们稍微游离于主流程之外，在一个为整个项目提供输入的支线流程中工作，但这意味着我们并不总是能得到我们想要的、适合我们的配置。"
"时间安排上也是一样。在临近比赛时，我们会从高性能动力单元部门接收信息，但有些决策和演进我们并不参与其中。当我们得知自己拿到了什么的时候，往往没有太多时间来做出反应和调整——所以我们今年努力做的事情之一，就是建立并改进我们的流程，让这一点不再成为那么大的限制。"
坦普尔表示，这需要进一步发展并让迈凯伦新成立的"动力单元性能团队"（power unit performance team）逐渐适应——"我们以前没有这样的团队"。"
"作为一项常规工作，HPP会进行模拟，并针对特定赛事和给定的练习阶段提出一套配置，同时给出多种不同的方案，说明如何在一圈内最好地利用能量。"
"然后，我们要用我们的工具以及MCL40赛车的具体要求来核对，还要考虑风向、抓地力水平、油箱里的燃油量等变量，等等。所以，我们会探索所有这些因素，并与我们认为是最佳的方案进行对比，然后向我们的比赛工程师以及高性能动力单元部门的工程师提出建议。
"这是一个非常协作的过程——但我们使用工具的方式有所不同，实际上我们的工具也与高性能动力单元部门略有不同，所以这是两种方法的结合。"
detailEn: Mercedes has a different explanation for why customer team McLaren has not been able to exploit its 2026 Formula 1 power unit as effectively as the works operation.

Defending champion McLaren not getting as much out of the power unit as Mercedes has been one of the major behind-the-scenes topics in the development of this year's title fight, and has been known to be a source of at least mild frustration for McLaren - one it has at least hinted at, if never fully expressed publicly.

Back at Silverstone in July, where McLaren expressed surprise at the qualifying power trick being used by the factory Mercedes cars, team principal Andrea Stella said: "There's definitely conversations ongoing with HPP [Mercedes High Performance Powertrains] at technical level to make sure that we use what is available in this power unit, which is brilliant. It's a really piece of great technology. There's a lot of performance, which is also in the details of the exploitation.

"...Definitely there's some other factors that we need to keep discussing with HPP, because when we look at the performance in the straights, even taking into account the fact that they [Mercedes] may have less drag, there's still some question marks."
The shorter gear ratios picked by McLaren at the start of the year based on early Mercedes info have been one such point of differentiation.

But according to Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord, simple intellectual property logistics and matters of spending - rather than any deliberate strategy from Mercedes to give its factory team a leg up - have been central to any difference in power unit exploitation.

"Everything is in the rules and everything is in the contract. I think McLaren and the other customer teams, Alpine and Williams, are great partners to work with, they're rightly demanding. They've chosen Mercedes because they choose to work with a company that provides excellent support and a great product," said Lord.
"The [power unit] team at Brixworth have proven over the last however-many-years of customer supply that they do that in a very even-handed and correct way.

"Where there have perhaps inevitably been perceptions of differences, or they [customers] have...felt potentially one step behind is in the...a lot of the simulation tools, the ability to predict behaviour of the power unit and the chassis and things like that.

"And a lot of those toolsets are things that we've developed not just at Brixworth but between MGP [Mercedes F1 team] chassis team and HPP at Brixworth - and obviously the technical regulations are very clear on what chassis team IP can and cannot be shared between teams as well.

"So, in some instances there is unpicking that needs to be done before elements can be then provided to the customer teams - or the customer teams themselves are needing to do work and spend, invest their own cost cap resource into developing the tools to be able to get the most from the power unit.
"So that's probably one of the complexities that we've bumped into - but kind of understandable in a brand new ruleset and a new ruleset that is more complex than the previous one."

McLaren beat Mercedes by 364 points in the constructors' standings last year, the final season of that regulation cycle, but currently trails by 159 points - though it did dominate the Hungarian Grand Prix with Lando Norris.

An interview it released with technical director for performance, Mark Temple during the summer break shed some more light on matters of power unit exploitation, and backed up some of what Lord said, while also stressing a fundamental "out of the main loop" characteristic of the team's customer status right now.

"I think some of it comes from how much influence you have over the design and the installation. We do have considerable input, but ultimately MGP [the Mercedes race team] have the final say with HPP on what happens. That shouldn't be taken to mean we're ignored - we're ultimately just not the ones in complete control.

“The way HPP work on a race weekend is with a main team and customer support teams. We work very closely with our customer support team and have good relationships with people in the main programme. From that, we have influence on what's happening within the main programme - but we don't have guarantees they'll accept things we request.
"We're a little out of the main loop in that respect, working in a side loop that feeds into the programme, but it means we don't always get the configurations we want and that would suit us.

"It's the same with the timeline. In the run-up to a race, we receive information from HPP, but there's decision-making and evolution we're not part of. When we find out what we've got, there's often not a huge amount of time to react and respond - so part of what we're trying to do this year is build and improve our process to make this less of a limitation."
Temple indicated this was a matter of further developing and acclimatising McLaren's new "power unit performance team, which we didn't have before".

"As a normal activity, HPP will do simulations and come up with a configuration for a particular event and a given session and present a multitude of different options of how best to use energy around the lap.

"We want to then check that against our tools and the specific requirements of the MCL40, plus variables like the wind direction, the grip level, the amount of fuel in the tank, and so on. So, we explore all of those things and compare them against what we think is optimal and then make recommendations to our race engineers alongside the HPP engineers.
"It's a very collaborative process - but we use some of our tools differently, and indeed have slightly different tools, to HPP, so it's a combination of the two approaches."
keyPointsZh: 迈凯伦未能充分发挥动力单元性能是本赛季争冠幕后主要话题之一，车队至少暗示过对此感到沮丧

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
